title: J.X: Besides — so Hoffmann of Helmstedt and other Lutherans cannot press that the Formula Concord inserted a spurious AC exemplar
pass_a_gloss: Besides, lest they be rightly pressed by Hoffmann of Helmstedt and other Lutheran theologians that a spurious exemplar of the Augsburg Confession was inserted into the Formula of Concord; see Hoffmann's Apology to Doctor Olearius and Paul Nicander, page 691, cited by the Author of the Appendix of the Ausführliche Behauptung, pages 29 and following.
pass_b_english: Besides, so Hoffmann of Helmstedt and other Lutheran theologians cannot rightly press that the Formula of Concord slipped in a spurious Augsburg Confession exemplar.
See Hoffmann's Apology to Dr. Olearius and Paul Nicander (p. 691), cited by the author of the Appendix to the Ausführliche Behauptung (pp. 29ff.).
source_text: Praeterea, ne ab Hoffmanno Helmstadiensi aliisque Lutheranis Theologis, jure urgeantur, Formulae Concordiae spurium Augustanae Confessionis Exemplar insertum esse; vide Hoffmanni Apologiam ad D. Olearium & Paulum Nicandrum, pag. 691. citatam Auctori des Anhangs der ausführlichen Behauptung pag. 29. & feqq.

lemmas.note: charge against Formula Concord's AC text
